invariants.rationale: The method returns the result of execute(), which presumably returns a non-null HoodieWriteMetadata as per usual convention.
The method likely assumes its input record list is non-null, as it passes it directly to another constructor/method.
An instant time should be defined for delete operations in versioned transactional systems.
The engine context is required for any engine operation and passed down without null handling here.
The returned object should always be an instance of HoodieWriteMetadata.
